candidats.description: Solis H26 compact tractor with topper mower-roller attachment at Holtwhites Trinibis Cricket Club , in Enfield, London. The Solis H26 is a 26 HP compact tractor typically used for small-scale farming, landscaping, and municipal work. It has a Mitsubishi 3-cylinder diesel engine, 2-range hydrostatic transmission (HST), and 4WD with differential lock. Standard equipment includes power steering, wet disc brakes, a 600 kg lift capacity (optional 775 kg), rear and mid PTOs, and a ROPS frame.
